rings.name: Golem Controller Ring
rings.description: A ring used to issue commands to Aetheric golems. Prized by engineers and artifact collectors.

rings.name: Mud Monarch Seal
rings.description: A golden seal once used by the Mud Monarchs to legitimize contracts. Opens doors that money usually cannot.

rings.name: Rusted Band of Knowledge
rings.description: A pitted ring carrying half-faded engravings of pre-Flood diagrams.

rings.name: Reclaimer's Quick Band
rings.description: A scavenger's ring with a fitted pry-edge. Quickens the hands that wear it.

rings.name: Tartarian Stoneband
rings.description: Heavy ring carved from a True Tartarian temple column. The wearer's grip never quite forgets it.

rings.name: Aether-Shard Ring
rings.description: Aether-Shard Ring. A scrap-metal band set with a sliver of Aether Shard. The wearer's thinking gets crisper near anything that hums.

rings.name: Ring of Shadows
rings.description: Conspiracy Architects issue. A matte-black band that drinks the light around your hand — the Architects' agents wear it to be the thing no one quite remembers seeing. (+2 Stealth)

rings.name: Titanhold Ring
rings.description: Servants of the Giants issue. Cast from a sliver of a sleeping Giant's fingerbone; the wearer borrows a fraction of that buried might. (+2 Strength)

rings.name: Tartarian Oath-Band
rings.description: True Tartarian issue. Sworn soldiers mean to take the surface back by hand; the band lends a soldier's strength to the oath. (+2 Strength)

rings.name: Light-Finger Guild Band
rings.description: Reclaimers Guild issue. Weighted to roll a relic into your palm before anyone sees the hand move. (+2 Dexterity)

rings.name: Ring of Forgotten Lore
rings.description: Forgotten Order issue. The band is etched edge-to-edge with pre-Flood proofs only the initiated can read; wearing it keeps them close. (+2 Intelligence)

rings.name: Revivalist's Aether-Coil
rings.description: Tartarian Revivalist issue. A coil of live Etheric wire wound to a band — it hums against the knuckle and sharpens the mind that would wake the old engines. (+2 Intelligence)

rings.name: Architect's Insight Ring
rings.description: Stone Builders issue. A surveyor's ring scored with a true right-angle; it steadies the eye that reads load, stress, and Architectural Sorcery. (+2 Wisdom)

rings.name: Monarch's Drowned Signet
rings.description: Mud Monarchs issue. A waterlogged signet whose authority outlived the court that pressed it — tongues and doors still open for the one who wears it. (+2 Charisma)

rings.name: Aetherborn Signet
rings.description: Eternal Dynasty issue. The signet of the Aetherborn line; to wear it is to be answered as though the blood were yours. (+2 Charisma)

rings.name: Aetherstone Signet
rings.description: A band set with a chip of humming Aetherstone. The wearer's mind runs a half-step ahead, and stray Aether slides off it.

rings.name: Titan's Iron Band
rings.description: A heavy ring hammered from old Tartarian iron, sized as if for a larger hand. It sets the wrist like a brace — blows that should land slide off the guard.

rings.name: Ring of the Deep Current
rings.description: Forged around a boss-heart core, it pulls the wearer along the buried country's hidden currents — never quite where a blow expects them to be.

rings.name: Tin Ward Ring
rings.description: A band of tin and rust-eating salt, worn smooth by a scavenger who never replaced a strap in his life. Corrosion slides off it — and off everything else you have on.

rings.name: Scribe's Signet
rings.description: A copyist’s signet, the seal worn flat by a thousand pressings. Whoever wears it reads the buried country the way its clerks once did.

rings.name: Ashfall Ring
rings.description: Lead beads strung on a wire loop, from the crews who worked the hot ground. Heavy on the hand, and the glow does not reach through it.

rings.name: Cinderward Ring
rings.description: A forge-master’s ring, the stone inside it still warm. It turns fire away from the hand that wears it and feeds any fire that hand is already carrying.

rings.name: Sparkwright Band
rings.description: Wound copper over a grounding pin. Current runs around the finger instead of through it, and whatever current you painted on your blade runs harder.

rings.name: Venomwright Band
rings.description: A poisoner’s working ring, the inner face pitted from decades of decanting. The trade teaches you both halves: what venom does, and what it does not do to you.

rings.name: Cutpurse's Band
rings.description: Flat, unpolished, nothing to catch a lantern. It teaches the hand where the seam in a man’s armour is before the eye has found it.

rings.name: Thunderclap Ring
rings.description: A stormcatcher’s ring, holding one charge and no more. When the fighting starts it lets go of it, all at once, into everything within arm’s reach.

rings.name: Ring of the Quiet Hand
rings.description: The guild made four of these and admits to none. The blow it guides does not land where the armour is; it lands where the man is.

rings.name: Rimebinder's Ring
rings.description: A band of clouded ice that never melts and never warms the finger. Once a fight it lets the winter out, and everything standing near enough feels the whole of it.
